title: HTTPRequest doesn't follow a specific redirect automatically
body:
### Tested versions

4.4 stable

### System information

Win10

### Issue description

I am trying to download into godot from this url:

`https://web.archive.org/web/https://poly.googleusercontent.com/downloads/c/fp/1623061107783986/9L2Lt-sxzdp/9CCR_YwpE17/model.gltf`

It doesn't work because `Condition "!_check_request_url(p_method, p_url)" is true. Returning: ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER`

after reading the source at `http_client_tcp` I see I should take out the extra `https://` in the archive.org link, but I still get the same error. 

So I tried URL encoding the offending parts of the url, still doesn't work.

I then tried HTTPClient instead. I made this very simple client to run the project and test the download.

```swift
extends Node  # Don't extend HTTPRequest, use HTTPClient properly




var http = HTTPClient.new()

func _ready():
	# Domain and path settings
	
	## cannot use this because it has a ":" in it, which godot reads as a parameter. I tried to uri encode this but to no avail.
	var original_url = "https://web.archive.org/web/https://poly.googleusercontent.com/downloads/c/fp/1623061107783986/9L2Lt-sxzdp/9CCR_YwpE17/model.gltf"


	var domain = "web.archive.org"
	var path = "poly.googleusercontent.com/downloads/c/fp/1623061107783986/9L2Lt-sxzdp/9CCR_YwpE17/model.gltf"
	
	# Printing the domain and path
	print("Domain:", domain)
	print("Path:", path)
	
	# Connect to the host
	print("Attempting to connect to host:", domain)
	var connect = http.connect_to_host(domain)
	print("Connect result:", connect)
	if connect != OK:
		http.request(domain, path, web_safe_headers)
		print(http.get_status())
	# Ensure connection is established before sending the request
	var attempts = 0
	while http.get_status() == HTTPClient.STATUS_CONNECTING:
		http.poll()
		attempts += 1
		print("Connecting... Attempt:", attempts, "Status:", http.get_status())

	# Check connection status after attempting to connect
	if http.get_status() != HTTPClient.STATUS_CONNECTED:
		print("Failed to connect after ", attempts, " attempts. Status:", http.get_status())
		return

	print("Successfully connected to", domain)

	# Send the GET request to the server
	print("Sending GET request to path:", path)
	var error = http.request(HTTPClient.METHOD_GET, path, web_safe_headers)
	print("Request result error code:", error)

	if error != OK:
		print("Request failed with error:", error)
		return

	# Handle the response body
	print("Waiting for response body...")
	var response_attempts = 0
	while http.get_status() == HTTPClient.STATUS_REQUESTING:
		http.poll()
		response_attempts += 1
		print("Waiting... Attempt:", response_attempts, "Status:", http.get_status())

	# Check if we have received the body of the response
	if http.get_status() == HTTPClient.STATUS_BODY:
		print("Response received. Reading response body...")
		var body = http.read_response_body()
		print("Response body (raw):", body.get_string_from_utf8())
	else:
		print("Request failed with status:", http.get_status())


var web_safe_headers : Array[String] = [
	"Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8",
	"Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd",
	"User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/134.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
]
```

and the output is just:

```
Domain:web.archive.org
Path:poly.googleusercontent.com/downloads/c/fp/1623061107783986/9L2Lt-sxzdp/9CCR_YwpE17/model.gltf
Attempting to connect to host:web.archive.org
Connect result:0
Failed to connect after 0 attempts. Status:1
```

I tried:
- `uri_encode()` on parts of the URL. testing the URL in browser shows it working, in godot its invalid parameter still (very confusing). here is one I tried:
`https://web.archive.org/web/poly.googleusercontent.com%2Fdownloads%2Fc%2Ffp%2F1623061107783986%2F9L2Lt-sxzdp%2F9CCR_YwpE17%2Fmodel.gltf`

- both `HTTPRequest` and `HTTPClient` 

I've made plenty of http requests that do work in this project, where I am able to download lots of thumbnails and data and generate nodes with that data, but when I touch a archive.org link, it just won't let me make the request, no matter what I try.






### Steps to reproduce

read above

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

that script above I shared could be tested in a blank project, but I can make one on request.
